title: SolidWorks Parametric Automation (Python + COM API)
summary: Python scripts driving SolidWorks' COM API to batch-update parametric dimensions across families of parts.
problem: Manually updating parametric dimensions across variant parts was slow and error-prone. The goal was to drive SolidWorks directly from Python to make configuration changes repeatable.
approach: Used pywin32 to bind to the SolidWorks COM API, working through a series of environment and binding issues to reliably open documents, edit dimensions and rebuild models from a script — turning a manual, repetitive task into a one-command operation.
solution: Used pywin32 to bind to the SolidWorks COM API, working through a series of environment and binding issues to reliably open documents, edit dimensions and rebuild models from a script — turning a manual, repetitive task into a one-command operation.
